sections.heading: Rajinikanth — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rajinikanth was born on 12 December 1950 in Bengaluru, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Shivaji Rao Gaekwad at birth and is publicly known as Rajinikanth.
Public records name his father, Ramoji Rao Gaekwad and his mother, Jijabai Shahaji Bhosale. He is a sibling of Sathyanarayana Rao Gaikwad, Nageshwar Rao Gaikwad and Aswath Balubhai.
He received his education at Adyar Film Institute and Acharya Pathasala Public School.
He is recorded as speaking Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi and English.

sections.heading: Rajinikanth — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rajinikanth works primarily as a film producer, screenwriter, film actor, singer and writer.
